Terrain only decides at tile (200 m) granularity. The plant-* zones were converted mechanically from src/city/sf/parks.ts (2026-09-28), first-match-wins becoming priority; plant-city is the old CITY_PARK/LAWN/WOOD default. ggp-* meadow zones and plant-sausalito added by hand the same day: rough rectangles, to be corrected.

zones.name: The Presidio (its buildings)

zones.name: Alcatraz
zones.note: Appearance audit 2026-10-02 (BUGS.md #257): on the coarse grid the island topped out 11 m above the sea; it rises about 41 m to the cellhouse. 2026-10-04: cliffs — the island meets the bay in rock all round (views audit).

zones.name: Strawberry Hill (Stow Lake's island)
zones.note: Golden Gate Park audit 2026-10-04: the 60 m opening took the summit off — a flat mesa 14 m over the lake at 101.7 m, where the zoom-15 data (bare earth here) reads 130.4 m. The ring is the island's own shore (the hole in Stow Lake) pushed 5% out into the water; water samples are never raw, so the lake keeps its level and no ridden way crosses the edge.

zones.name: Yerba Buena and Treasure Island
zones.note: Owner, 2026-10-02: 'There's WAY too much traffic; it's a mostly pedestrian area' (BUGS.md #254).

zones.name: Sausalito
zones.note: Owner, 2026-10-02: 'a destination … little car traffic … many low stucco Spanish colonial buildings, not big boxy buildings'.

zones.name: Fort Point
zones.note: The surf breaking on the seawall under the bridge (owner, 2026-10-02).

zones.name: Sutro Baths, Cliff House and Point Lobos
zones.note: Owner, 2026-10-02: 'i'm not seeing those unique buildings' — a forest stood over the baths, the Cliff House and the Camera Obscura. The real headland is bare cliff and scrub, cypress in ones and twos.

zones.name: Avenue of the Palms, Treasure Island
zones.note: Owner, 2026-10-02: 'avenue of the palms should have...palms'.

zones.name: Sutro Forest
zones.note: Appearance pass 2026-10-02: Mount Sutro rose bare under the tower; the real hill is the Sutro Forest, tall blue gum eucalyptus all round it.

zones.name: Treasure Island
zones.note: Owner, 2026-10-02: 'Treasure Island … need a lot of work'. The Navy's island: low stucco quarters and new mid-rise blocks, never the city's brick, Victorians or tenements. Landmarks (Building 1, the hangars) are models.

zones.name: Embarcadero Center podium
zones._note: 2026-10-03: the podium level's walks (src/city/sf/bridges.ts EMBARCADERO_PODIUM_DECKS) are mostly footways; open them to bikes so the promenade, the skybridges and Maritime Plaza are one rideable route (owner: 'walkable/bikeable … go either on the road beneath or on the aerial walkway'). 2026-10-03: extended north over Golden Gateway Center's 12-13 m podium, so its walks are rideable too (owner: 'the embarcadero decks are not navigable').

zones.name: Tree Fern Dell
zones._note: 2026-10-03: the dell of tree ferns below the Conservatory of Flowers (John McLaren's fern dell), by eye from the park map — refine from OSM if it is mapped.

zones.name: Seward Mini Park
zones._note: 2026-10-03 (owner: 'the park is heavily wooded'): thick planting either side of the slides; the slides and their path are a clearing (seward-slides.ts grounds). Ring from OSM way/138662530.

zones.name: Twin Peaks (the summits and Christmas Tree Point)
zones.note: Viewpoints audit 2026-10-04: the summits are bare grass and coastal scrub, not the hills' park planting (eucalyptus, oak, blossom) — trees stood on the lawn at the top and in the view.

zones.name: Corona Heights (the rocky summit)
zones.note: Viewpoints audit 2026-10-04: the summit is a bare red-chert outcrop and grass; the park's trees are on its lower slopes by the Randall Museum.

zones.name: Tank Hill (the summit)
zones.note: Viewpoints audit 2026-10-04: a small bare rock summit with the view; eucalyptus round its foot.

zones.name: marin-headlands
zones.note: 2026-10-04 (views audit): the Marin Headlands are open coastal scrub with wind-bent cypress and a few eucalyptus groves; under the city's default mix they grew pink blossom and street trees. Rough rectangle south of Sausalito's own zone.

zones.name: alcatraz
zones.note: 2026-10-04 (audit): Alcatraz's planting is wind-blown eucalyptus and cypress over the ruins' gardens, not the city's park mix (palms, blossom).

zones.name: Presidio Tunnel Tops
zones.note: The Tunnel Tops (2022) are planted beds — bark mulch and low native shrubs between tan gravel paths, the oval lawns OSM maps the only grass (Commons 'Presidio Tunnel Tops aerial (cropped).jpg'; the owner's reference list, 2026-10-04). Ring: OSM way/91114607, the park's own outline.

zones.name: Yerba Buena Island light station cliff
zones.note: The lighthouse stands ~20 m up a sandstone cliff (owner's photograph, 2026-10-04); the coarse ground put it 2 m above the water. Fine raw relief over the station's shore, as Alcatraz (#257).
